name: Summoner
description: Builds Command through summon-tagged actions and improves summon effects without creating summons by itself.

focuses.name: Grand Rally
focuses.description: Rally Command lasts 4 seconds longer. Controlled allies gain +10% Effect Potency during Rally Command. Solo fallback: you gain +5% Effect Potency during Rally Command.

focuses.name: Last Bastion Order
focuses.description: Once per Rally Command, if a controlled ally would die, prevent death and give it a Barrier equal to 15% of your Max Health for 4 seconds. If you have no controlled allies, Rally Command cooldown is reduced by 50% when you fall below 35% Health. 90 second internal cooldown.

focuses.name: Overwhelming Coordination
focuses.description: During Rally Command, each controlled ally or active persistent Essence effect grants your next Essence ability +2% Effect Potency, capped at +12%. If you have no controlled allies or persistent effects, count as 2 stacks.

coreMechanic: Gain Command from Summon-tagged active abilities. At 100 Command, empower the next Summon-tagged effect.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.

skillTreeNodes.name: Proxy Command
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: DeliveryConversion + SummonConversion. Eligible Essence abilities may be delivered through your strongest controlled ally once every 8 seconds. Hostile abilities use your stats but originate from the ally's position and target, resolving at 75% Effect Potency. Non-hostile abilities use the ally as the origin point at 85% Effect Potency. If no controlled ally exists, your next persistent Essence effect gains +10% duration instead.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching DeliveryConversion, SummonConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Shared Instinct
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: SupportConversion + SummonConversion. When you heal, barrier, buff, or cleanse yourself, your strongest controlled ally receives 35% of the effect. When you heal, barrier, buff, or cleanse a controlled ally, you receive 20% of the effect. If no controlled ally exists, self-targeted non-hostile Essence effects gain +5% Effect Potency.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching SupportConversion, SummonConversion.

If no controlled ally exists, your next DamageOverTime, Aura, Trap, or Persistent Essence effect against that target gains +4% Effect Potency.
